# Commit message format

- Use conventional commit subject: `<type>(<scope>): <summary>`.
- Keep commit body as compact bullet points with NO blank lines between bullets.
- Example:
  - `feat(layout): migrate app to Tailwind component structure`
  - `- Move routes into (main)/(with-header) and remove legacy app pages`
  - `- Add new src-based layout and feature component structure`
  - `- Convert header, footer, and shared section styling to Tailwind utilities`
  - `- Define reusable brand color token in global theme styles`
